finalText:
Build's clean now. The real bug was in `src/core/settings.js:17` — it referenced an undefined variable `retries` instead of `env.retries`, which crashed the link stage every time. I fixed it to fall back to `3` when not given.

Everything else was just noise: three warnings (a deprecated crypto call, an unused export, a circular import) that don't stop the build. It now finishes with exit code `0`, "3 warnings, 0 errors."
